Control your Smart TV effortlessly with iMote — the ultimate universal remote control for TV. Whether you need a simple remote control for TV or a powerful smart TV remote, iMote transforms your smartphone into the perfect TV controller that works with all major TV brands. This universal remote app offers a seamless TV control experience that puts a smart TV remote and remote control for TV right in your pocket.

Seamlessly manage your TV control with a single app: adjust volume, switch inputs, launch apps, or cast your favorite media with ease. iMote is the smart TV remote designed to simplify your entertainment experience and provide a universal remote solution for all your TV control needs.

Download iMote now — the best universal remote for your TV — and unlock full control at your fingertips with this smart TV remote and TV controller app!

◉ FREE FEATURES:

√ UNIVERSAL REMOTE CONTROL FOR TV

√ SCREEN MIRRORING

Experience real-time screen mirroring with zero lag or interruptions. Stream your phone screen to your TV effortlessly, perfect for showing slideshows, watching movies, or playing mobile games on the big screen. This screen mirroring feature works flawlessly with your smart TV remote.

√ CAST MEDIA

Easily cast videos, photos, and music from your smartphone or tablet to your Smart TV. Enjoy seamless media casting with just a few taps using your universal remote control for TV.

√ INTUITIVE REMOTE UI

Navigate your TV with a sleek, easy-to-use interface designed to mimic traditional remotes, making your TV controller experience smooth and straightforward.

√ APPS SCREEN

Manage and launch TV apps directly from your phone. Browse streaming services and installed apps without the need for the physical remote control.

√ PERSONALIZE SETTINGS

Customize iMote to fit your preferences. Adjust settings for a personalized TV control experience with your smart TV remote.

◉ PREMIUM FEATURES:

√ NO ADS

Enjoy an uninterrupted, ad-free experience when upgrading to iMote Premium.

√ ADVANCED REMOTE FUNCTIONS

Unlock advanced playback controls such as fast forward and rewind, plus customizable button layouts for a truly personalized TV controller.

√ UNLIMITED CASTING & SCREEN MIRRORING

Cast and mirror any media without restrictions. Stream videos, photos, and music or mirror your device screen to your TV in real-time, completely interruption-free with this powerful smart TV remote and universal remote control for TV.

√ PRIORITY SUPPORT

Get fast, priority assistance with iMote Premium customer support for any questions or issues.

Take your TV control to the next level with iMote — the universal remote control for TV that combines simplicity, power, and smart TV remote features all in one app. Download now and enjoy total TV control!
